next_action.title: Reduce the crease with an incremental glue pull
next_action.tools: Controlled glue-pull lifter, compatible flexible crease tab, adhesive and release agent, PDR light
next_action.approach: Start reducing the creased low with a shape-matched flexible tab. Reassess before progressing to narrower detail work.
steps: Find the creased low at the displayed landmarks. Align a compatible flexible crease tab along it; the outline locates damage and is not a tab-placement guide.
Follow the glue system's preparation and attachment instructions, then set the lifter using its product instructions.
Apply one small controlled lift. Release the adhesive as instructed and stop before the low becomes a raised ridge.
Add the next photo and any action note. The copilot will assess the crease and surrounding depression before choosing the next adjustment.
next_action.expected_change: The crease and surrounding depression should soften. Remaining distortion may need further work; a complete repair is not expected from one lift.
next_action.stop_when: Stop if paint changes, a ridge rises, the tab cannot be aligned on the low, or the lifter cannot be supported as specified. Do not bridge a panel seam.
next_action.scope: Prototype adaptation of a manufacturer technique for visible creased lows. This vehicle's suitability and exact tool setup are not established by the image.

physical_preconditions: The applicable vehicle procedure and panel material must permit the method; the historical Rivian statement is not current authorization.
The coating must pass the required inspection, and the tool and adhesive setup must follow their product instructions.
